description:
Read one of the organization's skills kept on Valet. Call it only when the user names Valet or a skill, or asks Valet for work that a listed skill's description covers. governance holds the organization's requirements for Valet: read it before you create or publish anything there.

Returns the skill's SKILL.md, the paths of its supporting files, its version, and its source: org is the organization's own content and overrides Valet's; default is Valet's, for a well-known name the organization has not written, and for design-system reason says why a selected preset could not be honored. Pass its version to publish_skill as base_version when you change the skill. Read a supporting file with path only when SKILL.md says to.

all_files returns every text file; to install them, write each under ~/.claude/skills/<name>/ or ~/.agents/skills/<name>/. git returns a read-only clone URL with no credential, valid for an hour, with the commands to clone it using a key you generate: pass key_sha256, the SHA-256 of a key kept on your machine, made as create_push describes. Then change the skill through create_push and publish_skill with push, and pass that version to publish_skill as base_version. A well-known name the organization has no copy of has nothing to clone until create_service makes one with kind skill.

This requires a connected account.

all_files.description: Return SKILL.md and every other text file in one answer, and list binary files with their sizes. Refused for a skill over the per-call limits, with the git recipe. Not allowed with path or git.

git.description: Return a read-only Git URL for the organization's skill, its latest version and that version's commit, and the commands to clone it and check out that commit, instead of its content. Prefer it when you can run git with network access. Requires key_sha256. The URL carries no credential and works for an hour. Pass the version to publish_skill as base_version. Not allowed with path, release, or all_files.

key_sha256.description: With git: the lowercase hex SHA-256 (64 characters) of a Git key you generated on your machine. Never send the key itself.

org_name.description: The Valet organization whose skill to read. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

path.description: The path of one supporting file to read instead of the skill's SKILL.md, as an earlier get_skill listed it. Omit to read the skill itself.

release.description: A release version from list_releases. Omit to read the latest. Not allowed with git.

skill.description: Required. The skill's name: governance, design-system, or any name list_skills reports.

name: get_skill
title: Read an organization skill
